description: Codex: Orks (11e) DUBIOUS RESTRAINT (Taktikal Brigade, 1 CP) through the real movement_phase_start window, including the objective pick. The save loads into the Orks' Command phase; setup lines the Kommandos up between obj_nml_1 and obj_center so the unit controls BOTH. Ending the Command phase starts the Movement phase, which opens the movement_phase_start window for the Ork player: the StratagemDialog shows DUBIOUS RESTRAINT with an enabled 'Use on Kommandos' button. A real click on Use opens the objective picker (the unit controls two); a real click on obj_nml_1 spends 1 CP and secures that objective (14.03) — and only that one. With every Kommando then taken out of range, the secured objective stays under Ork control. Setup-only privileges: Taktikal Brigade detachment (stratagems reloaded); Kommandos repositioned; Boyz B, Custodian Guard A and the Prosecutors moved off the two objectives so the Kommandos alone control them.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Taktikal Brigade; the Kommandos line up from obj_nml_1 to obj_center and control both
the Boyz control no objective now — not offered
